nodes.text: Hands where I can see them, and I mean that kindly, I want to check your gloves for wear. Hm. Road gloves. You will want better.
The cage is open. What do you need?

choices.text: Why does a hideout need a quartermaster?

nodes.text: Because heroics die of wet boots. The watch has an armory, the Waykeepers have a chapter house, and the Company has me, and of the three of us I am the only one whose people come home dry. Steel is a tool. Leather is a tool. The docket pays for hides because I MAKE it pay for hides.
Second pick is yours. The blades already ate.
Dry boots, sharp steel, shut mouth. You have two of those. Work on the third.
